## Critical Constraint
queue_item_id is NOT the only proof of governance. All execution methods from the
taxonomy are valid. A MANUAL_GOVERNED_BY_SKILL mutation with full evidence is
equally valid as a QUEUE_DISPATCHED_EXECUTION.

## Validator 1: execution_method_required_validator
Inputs: evidence-declaration.yaml
Outputs: PASS / FAIL with item list
Fail: Any PRODUCT_SOURCE item has no execution_method field
Warn: execution_method=UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_METHOD
Exemptions: 2-sprint grace for pre-taxonomy items with backfill_pending note
Tests required: valid method PASS, missing field FAIL, UNKNOWN WARN
Blocks sprint: YES (after grace period)

## Validator 2: source_diff_required_validator
Inputs: evidence-declaration.yaml, declared source_diff_paths
Outputs: PASS / FAIL
Fail: PRODUCT_SOURCE item lacks source_diff_paths with no exemption
Warn: source_diff_paths=MISSING_BACKFILL_REQUIRED
Exemptions: legacy_backfill, pre_taxonomy_work (2-sprint grace)
Tests required: diff exists PASS, missing without exemption FAIL
Blocks sprint: YES for new work; WARN for backfill

## Validator 3: idempotency_key_required_validator
Inputs: evidence-declaration.yaml, sidecar attribution files
Outputs: PASS / FAIL
Fail: PRODUCT_SOURCE item has no idempotency_key
Warn: key present but no sidecar or source marker
Exemptions: pre_taxonomy_work with backfill note
Blocks sprint: YES for new work

## Validator 4: replay_recipe_required_validator
Inputs: evidence-declaration.yaml, claim_classification
Outputs: PASS / FAIL
Fail: claim_classification=REPLAYABLE_* but replay_recipe_path absent
Warn: claim=GOVERNED_BUT_NOT_REPLAYED (acceptable)
Exemptions: LEGACY_BACKFILLED never needs recipe
Blocks sprint: YES if REPLAYABLE claim without recipe

## Validator 5: claim_classification_validator
Inputs: evidence-declaration.yaml
Outputs: PASS / FAIL
Fail: claim_classification=INVALID_CLAIM; REPLAYABLE claim with MANUAL_UNGOVERNED method
Warn: WORKS_BUT_NOT_REPEATABLE (acceptable)
Blocks sprint: YES for INVALID_CLAIM

## Validator 6: legacy_backfill_validator
Inputs: .local/attribution/**/*.attribution.yaml
Outputs: PASS / WARN
Fail: none (backfill is remediation, not blocking)
Warn: PRODUCT_SOURCE item with no execution_method after 2-sprint grace
Blocks sprint: NO

## Validator 7: manual_ungoverned_rejection_validator
Inputs: evidence-declaration.yaml
Outputs: PASS / FAIL

Exemptions: LEGACY_BACKFILLED allows it as backfill entry
Blocks sprint: YES

## Validator 9: source_marker_or_sidecar_attribution_validator
